### Map aggregate means.
```{r}

# # Fix invalid geometries
# mean_per_district_tx0 <- st_make_valid(mean_per_district_tx0)
# districts_sf <- st_make_valid(districts_sf)
# mean_per_district_tx0 <- mean_per_district_tx0[!st_is_empty(mean_per_district_tx0), ]
# districts_sf <- districts_sf[!st_is_empty(districts_sf), ]


map_mort_tx0_child_aggregate <- ggplot(districts_sf_aggregate) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = mean_tx0), color = NA) +   # district polygons
  geom_sf(data = districts_sf %>% filter(adm_01=="Dosso"),
          fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.7) +   # boundaries
  coord_sf(crs = 4326) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(x="Longitude",y="Latitude",
       title = "A. Control (Placebo + Infant Azithro)", fill = "Mean mortality rate (per 1000 person-years)") + 
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "D", direction = 1,
                     limits = c(0,12),
                     na.value = NA,
                     breaks = seq(0,12,2),
                     guide=guide_colorbar(title="Mean mortality rate (per 1000 person-years)", 
                                          title.position = "top",
                                          title.hjust = 0.5,
                                          direction="horizontal",
                                          label.position = "bottom",
                                          label.hjust = 0.5,
                                          barheight=unit(10,"pt"),
                                          barwidth=unit(200,"pt"),
                                          ticks.colour = "white",
                                          ticks.linewidth = 1,
                                          frame.colour = "white") )


map_mort_tx1_child_aggregate <- ggplot(districts_sf_aggregate) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = mean_tx1), color = NA) +   # district polygons
  geom_sf(data = districts_sf %>% filter(adm_01=="Dosso"),
          fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.7) +   # boundaries
  coord_sf(crs = 4326) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(x="Longitude",y="Latitude",
       title = "B. Treatment (Child Azithro)", fill = "Mean mortality rate (per 1000 person-years)") + 
  scale_fill_viridis(option = "D", direction = 1,
                     limits = c(0,12),
                     na.value = NA,
                     breaks = seq(0,12,2),
                     guide=guide_colorbar(title="Mean mortality rate (per 1000 person-years)", 
                                          title.position = "top",
                                          title.hjust = 0.5,
                                          direction="horizontal",
                                          label.position = "bottom",
                                          label.hjust = 0.5,
                                          barheight=unit(10,"pt"),
                                          barwidth=unit(200,"pt"),
                                          ticks.colour = "white",
                                          ticks.linewidth = 1,
                                          frame.colour = "white") )


map_mort_diff_child_aggregate <- ggplot(districts_sf_aggregate) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = mean_ATE), color = NA) +   # district polygons
  geom_sf(data = districts_sf %>% filter(adm_01=="Dosso"),
          fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.7) +   # boundaries
  coord_sf(crs = 4326) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(x="Longitude",y="Latitude",
       title = "C. ATE", fill = "Mean ATE: difference in mortality per 1000 person-years") + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(midpoint=0,
                       low = muted("dodgerblue"),
                       mid = "white",
                       high = muted("red"),
                       limits = c(-1.5,0),
                       breaks = seq(-1.5,0,0.25),
                       labels = as.character(seq(-1.5,0,0.25)),
                       na.value = NA,
                       guide=guide_colorbar(title="Mean ATE: difference in mortality per 1000 person-years", 
                                            title.position = "top",
                                            title.hjust = 0.5,
                                            direction="horizontal",
                                            label.position = "bottom",
                                            label.hjust = 0.5,
                                            barheight=unit(10,"pt"),
                                            barwidth=unit(200,"pt"),
                                            ticks.colour = "white",
                                            ticks.linewidth = 1,
                                            frame.colour = "white",
                                            draw.llim = T,
                                            draw.ulim = T))
  


```


```{r}

map_mort_tx0_child_aggregate; map_mort_tx1_child_aggregate; map_mort_diff_child_aggregate

map_mort_child_aggregate <- 
  ggarrange(map_mort_tx0_child_aggregate,
            map_mort_tx1_child_aggregate,
            map_mort_diff_child_aggregate,
            nrow = 2, ncol = 2)

ggsave(filename = paste0(figure_path,"/spatial-map-panels-district/avenir-spatial-ATE-map-aggregate-",Sys.Date(),".pdf"),
       map_mort_child_aggregate,
       device = "pdf", 
       width = 250,
       height = 320,
       units = "mm")

ggsave(filename = paste0(figure_path,"/spatial-map-panels-district/avenir-spatial-ATE-map-aggregate-",Sys.Date(),".png"),
       map_mort_child_aggregate,
       device = "png", 
       width = 250,
       height = 320,
       units = "mm")

save.image(paste0("~/Documents/GitHub/AVENIR-spatial-ate/data-",Sys.Date(),".RData"))
# Note to self: data-2024-12-10.RData has the simulate() results.

```
